_comment: DrawStack QA surface — 5 pages selected for post-deploy visual regression

pages.label: Marketing Home
pages.why: First impression + SEO anchor. Layout breaks here are immediately user-facing and conversion-killing.
pages.check: Hero headline, CTA button, nav bar, pricing CTA present and not broken

pages.label: Pricing Page
pages.why: Conversion-critical. Pricing table layout, plan names, and CTA buttons are visually sensitive.
pages.check: Plan cards visible, prices correct, upgrade CTAs present, no overflow/clipping

pages.label: Rabbet Comparison Page
pages.why: High-intent SEO landing page. Comparison table layout is fragile and differentiates DrawStack.
pages.check: Comparison table intact, feature rows aligned, CTA visible

pages.label: Sign In Page
pages.why: Auth gate for all users. A broken sign-in page = 100% of users locked out.
pages.check: Clerk sign-in widget rendered, no blank page, email/password fields present

pages.label: Blog Index
pages.why: SEO traffic entry point. Post cards must render correctly; layout breaks hurt crawlability.
pages.check: Blog post cards visible, titles readable, images loading
